title: E.T. Whittaker's 1904-1905 papers showing scalar waves are feasible

tellings.quote: fundamental papers of ET Whitaker 1904 1905 a English British mathematician by the name of ET Whitaker writes these two fundamental papers whereby he actually shows that scalar waves non herzian

plain: Two papers by the English mathematician E.T. Whittaker, which the tellers date to 1904 and 1905, are said to show that scalar waves are possible. These would be a kind of wave unlike ordinary radio waves, which the guest calls "non-Hertzian." Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents for unusual craft, gives this to Michels as his own reading of the papers, which he calls "fundamental." He also names the writer Tom Bearden. The papers' own words are not quoted, so whether they make that exact claim is left to his reading.
